title: Advancing LLM Reasoning Generalists with Preference Trees
authors_zh: Lifan Yuan, Ganqu Cui, Hanbin Wang, Ning Ding, Xingyao Wang, Boji Shan, Zeyuan Liu, Jia Deng, Huimin Chen, Ruobing Xie, Yankai Lin, Zhenghao Liu, Bowen Zhou, Hao Peng, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong Sun
paper_type_zh: 推理示范数据集与偏好树构造配方
best_for_zh: 适合构建或审计数学、代码与逻辑推理 SFT 数据的读者。
one_line: UltraInteract turns objectively checked reasoning actions and correction trajectories into public SFT demonstrations and companion preference pairs.
UltraInteract 把经过客观检查的推理动作与纠错轨迹转成公开的 SFT 示范，并同时发布偏好对。
why: It exposes how instructions, actor-generated rationales, execution feedback, critiques, and correctness decisions become reusable reasoning post-training records.
inclusion_reason: UltraInteract makes correct reasoning actions and interaction-conditioned trajectories into released SFT demonstrations, exposes their record schema and selection rules, and directly tests their contribution to downstream reasoning training.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Open reasoning models were typically specialized for either mathematics or code, while general alignment corpora did not teach difficult planning, tool execution, correction from feedback, and objective correctness in one inspectable record. This left open models well behind proprietary reasoning generalists and made it hard to tell which post-training actions were actually correct.

The paper constructs UltraInteract as one preference tree per instruction: actor models propose step-marked text or code actions, an environment and critique expose errors, and objectively correct nodes or trajectories become SFT demonstrations while correct/incorrect branches also form preference pairs. The direct release is a reusable reasoning post-training corpus plus Eurus consumers trained from its correct actions.

L4 facts: Primary source: OpenReview 2ea5TNVR0c; venue/date: ICLR 2025 Poster; decision boundary: released reasoning demonstrations are the primary Track 01 object, while preference learning and reward modeling are companion uses; atlas relevance: instruction, rationale, observation, critique, correctness, and lineage remain auditable; data surface: current public Parquet files contain 288,579 SFT rows and 219,522 preference rows; collection note: L4_carded, one controlled category.

开放推理模型通常只专精于数学或代码，而通用对齐语料没有在同一条可检查记录中同时教授困难规划、工具执行、根据反馈纠错和客观正确性。这使开放模型与专有推理通才仍有明显差距，也让数据维护者难以判断哪些训练动作确实正确。

论文为每条指令构造一棵 UltraInteract 偏好树：生成模型给出带步骤标记的文本或代码动作，环境与批评信息暴露错误，客观检查通过的节点或轨迹成为 SFT 示范，正确与错误分支还可形成偏好对。直接产物是可复用的推理后训练语料，以及用其中正确动作训练的 Eurus 模型。

L4 事实：主要来源为 OpenReview 2ea5TNVR0c；正式发表为 ICLR 2025 Poster；判定边界以公开推理示范为 Track 01 主对象，偏好学习和奖励建模只是配套用途；图谱价值在于指令、推理过程、观察、批评、正确性与谱系均可审计；当前公开文件含 288,579 条 SFT 记录和 219,522 条偏好记录；收录状态为 L4_carded，仅使用一个受控分类。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
# Core idea

UltraInteract changes a reasoning demonstration from an isolated answer into a branch of a preference tree: objective answer or execution checks decide which actor-written actions become SFT targets, while failed branches can receive observations and critiques before another attempt. The trainable correct action or trajectory is the primary object, ground-truth correctness is the selection boundary, and the companion chosen/rejected pairs do not make preference optimization the Card's central category.

Google Scholar citations: 216（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Advancing+LLM+Reasoning+Generalists+with+Preference+Trees&author=Lifan+Yuan&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes Dataset name: UltraInteract_sft, with UltraInteract_pair as the companion preference release Official URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/openbmb/UltraInteract_sft Scale: the current SFT file has 288,579 rows and the current pair file has 219,522 rows; the paper reports 85,918 source instructions, 286,979 correct answers, and 219,819 pairs Record form: SFT rows contain task, dataset, instruction, response, id, and parent_id; pair rows contain task, dataset, trajectory, chosen, rejected, id, and parent_id File / storage format: one public Parquet train file per release, with actual SFT schema and a row read successfully on 2026-07-14 Domains / languages: English mathematics, Python-oriented coding, logical reasoning, table reasoning, and tool-assisted question answering Construction and filtering: actor models write CoT or code actions, ground truth and execution select correct actions, environment feedback plus GPT-4 critique extend failed branches, syntax and decontamination filters remove invalid records License / access constraints: both Hugging Face releases are public, non-gated, and tagged MIT; upstream component datasets retain source-specific terms Intended use: reasoning SFT from correct actions or trajectories, preference learning from paired branches, reward modeling, and data-lineage audit

# 核心思想

UltraInteract 不再把推理示范视为孤立答案，而把它表示成偏好树中的一个分支：答案或执行的客观检查决定哪些模型动作成为 SFT 目标，失败分支则可先接收环境观察与批评再重新尝试。主要对象是可训练的正确动作或轨迹，筛选边界是基于标准答案的正确性；配套的正负偏好对并不会把本 Card 的中心分类变成偏好优化。

Google Scholar 引用数：216（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Advancing+LLM+Reasoning+Generalists+with+Preference+Trees&author=Lifan+Yuan&hl=en）

开源数据：有 数据集名称：UltraInteract_sft，另有配套偏好数据 UltraInteract_pair 官方地址：https://huggingface.co/datasets/openbmb/UltraInteract_sft 规模：当前 SFT 文件有 288,579 条记录，当前偏好文件有 219,522 条记录；论文报告 85,918 条源指令、286,979 个正确答案和 219,819 个偏好对 记录形式：SFT 记录包含任务、源数据集、指令、回答、编号和父编号；偏好记录还包含交互轨迹以及选中与拒绝动作 文件与存储格式：每个发布各有一个公开 Parquet 训练文件；2026-07-14 已实际读取 SFT 的字段结构和一条记录 领域与语言：英文数学、面向 Python 的代码、逻辑推理、表格推理和工具辅助问答 构造与过滤：模型生成思维链或代码动作，由标准答案和执行结果筛出正确动作；环境反馈与 GPT-4 批评扩展失败分支，再用语法和去污染规则删除无效记录 许可与访问限制：两个 Hugging Face 发布均公开、无需审批并标注 MIT；上游组成数据仍受各自条款约束 预期用途：从正确动作或轨迹进行推理 SFT，利用分支对开展偏好学习与奖励建模，以及审计数据谱系

title: Method
方法
html:
# Method

Step 1 - Select difficult, checkable instructions. Input: Twelve math, coding, and logic datasets with answers, rationales, tests, or other ground-truth signals. Operation: Retain diverse task forms, emphasize questions that GPT-3.5-Turbo fails, and stratify or difficulty-filter MathQA, NumGLUE, and TabMWP as described in Appendix A.1. Output and transition: 85,918 instruction roots enter preference-tree construction with their source labels and oversight material. Check / stop rule: A source must support a stated reasoning pattern and, except Magicoder-Evol-Instruct, objective correctness checking; otherwise it is not used for preference pairs.

Step 2 - Generate diverse correct and incorrect actions. Input: An instruction, a sampled CoT or modular-programming schema, GPT-3.5-Turbo as the default actor, alternative open actors, tools, and ground-truth annotations. Operation: The actor decomposes the problem and writes marked text or code actions; the pipeline samples 20 actions per attempt, retries up to three rounds with stronger actors, and then uses task-specific ground-truth access to elicit remaining hard correct actions. Output and transition: Syntax-valid candidate actions, including at least one correct action when construction succeeds, are available for pairing and branch expansion. Check / stop rule: Dataset answers, test cases, or execution decide correctness; Python syntax failures are removed, and GPT-4 Turbo judgments on Magicoder records are not treated as rigorous preference labels.

Step 3 - Expand failed actions into a preference tree. Input: A paired correct and incorrect action plus the interaction history. Operation: A Python environment returns output or traceback and a binary correctness signal; GPT-4 receives the history and ground-truth reference, locates the error, and writes a critique before the actor retries from the failed branch. Output and transition: Each instruction accumulates a root-to-leaf interaction trajectory and turn-level correct/incorrect branches. Check / stop rule: A correct action closes its branch, an incorrect action may continue, and construction stops after at most five turns.

Step 4 - Filter, decontaminate, and serialize training records. Input: Completed trees, source metadata, correctness labels, and evaluation test sets. Operation: Export correct actions and correct-ending trajectories to the SFT schema, export paired branches to the preference schema, exact-match LeetCode, run 8-gram matching on other same-task tests, and remove overlaps. Output and transition: Public Parquet releases expose 288,579 SFT rows and 219,522 preference rows in their current revisions. Check / stop rule: Only objectively accepted actions enter preference pairs; current file schemas and one SFT row must be readable, and the unexplained release-versus-paper count delta remains an audit note.

Step 5 - Train and compare Eurus consumers. Input: Mistral-7B or CodeLLaMA-70B, UltraInteract correct actions, and a smaller UltraChat/ShareGPT/OpenOrca mixture. Operation: Run one SFT epoch, then optionally apply DPO, KTO, or NCA to the preference data and train a reward model on UltraInteract plus companion feedback datasets. Output and transition: Eurus SFT/preference models, Eurus-RM-7B, and fixed reasoning, instruction-following, and multi-turn evaluation results. Check / stop rule: Benchmark accuracy or success rate measures the consumers; the SFT data ablation must compare the full recipe with ground-truth replacement, open-source-only, and UltraInteract-only variants.

Reproducibility: verify the ICLR/OpenReview record, the exact Hugging Face revisions, both Parquet schemas, the twelve source revisions, prompt templates, actor and critique model versions, ground-truth adapters, syntax/decontamination scripts, and one-epoch mixture. Fix actor sampling order, 20-action attempts, five-turn cap, SFT mixture sizes, learning rates, and benchmark splits. Actor temperatures, total generation cost, per-source license reconciliation, the cause of the 1,600-row SFT count delta, and a step-level semantic audit are not disclosed.

# 方法

步骤 1——选择困难且可检查的指令。 输入：十二个数学、代码和逻辑数据集，其中带有答案、推理说明、测试用例或其它标准信号。 操作：保留多样的任务形式，重点选择 GPT-3.5-Turbo 无法解决的问题，并按附录 A.1 对部分来源做分层抽样或难度过滤。 输出与流转：85,918 个带来源标签和监督材料的指令根节点进入偏好树构造。 检查或停止规则：来源必须支持明确的推理模式；除 Magicoder-Evol-Instruct 外，还必须能客观检查正确性，否则不用于构造偏好对。

步骤 2——生成多样的正确与错误动作。 输入：一条指令、随机选择的思维链或模块化编程模式、默认生成模型、其它开放模型、工具和标准标注。 操作：生成模型先分解问题，再写出带标记的文本或代码动作；每轮采样 20 个动作，最多用更强模型重试三轮，仍无法得到正确动作时再按任务类型提供标准推理或答案。 输出与流转：语法有效的候选动作在构造成功时至少含一个正确动作，随后进入配对和分支扩展。 检查或停止规则：数据集答案、测试用例或执行结果判断正确性；删除 Python 语法失败项，且不把 GPT-4 Turbo 对 Magicoder 记录的判断当作严格偏好标签。

步骤 3——把失败动作扩展成偏好树。 输入：一对正确与错误动作，以及此前的交互历史。 操作：Python 环境返回输出或报错和二元正确性信号；GPT-4 读取历史及标准答案，定位错误并给出批评，再由生成模型沿失败分支重试。 输出与流转：每条指令逐步形成从根到叶的交互轨迹，以及每轮的正确和错误分支。 检查或停止规则：正确动作关闭所在分支，错误动作可以继续扩展，每棵树最多五轮后停止。

步骤 4——过滤、去污染并序列化训练记录。 输入：构造完成的偏好树、来源元数据、正确性标签和评测测试集。 操作：把正确动作和以正确动作结束的轨迹导出为 SFT 格式，把成对分支导出为偏好格式；对 LeetCode 做精确匹配，对其它同任务测试集做八元组匹配并删除重合项。 输出与流转：当前公开 Parquet 文件包含 288,579 条 SFT 记录和 219,522 条偏好记录。 检查或停止规则：只有客观检查通过的动作才进入偏好对；文件字段和一条真实 SFT 记录必须可读，发布文件与论文统计的差异继续保留为审计项。

步骤 5——训练并比较 Eurus 消费模型。 输入：Mistral-7B 或 CodeLLaMA-70B、UltraInteract 正确动作，以及较小的通用指令混合数据。 操作：先进行一个周期的 SFT，再可选地对偏好数据使用 DPO、KTO 或 NCA，并用 UltraInteract 与配套反馈数据训练奖励模型。 输出与流转：得到 Eurus 的 SFT 与偏好模型、Eurus-RM-7B，以及固定的推理、指令遵循和多轮评测结果。 检查或停止规则：用基准准确率或成功率衡量模型；SFT 数据消融必须比较完整配方、标准答案替换、仅开放数据和仅 UltraInteract 四种设置。

复现要求：核验 ICLR 与 OpenReview 记录、精确的 Hugging Face 版本、两个 Parquet 字段结构、十二个来源版本、提示模板、生成与批评模型版本、标准答案适配器、语法与去污染脚本，以及一个训练周期的数据混合。固定模型采样顺序、每轮 20 个动作、五轮上限、SFT 混合规模、学习率和评测切分。论文未披露生成温度、总生成成本、逐来源许可核对、SFT 多出 1,600 条记录的原因和逐步语义审计。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
# Evidence

Claim: UltraInteract's generated, checked actions add more useful reasoning supervision than either the original source answers or the general alignment mixture alone. Controlled setup: Table 5 evaluates Eurus-7B-SFT over averaged coding, mathematics, BBH, and IFEval results; the full recipe uses UltraInteract plus the general SFT mixture, Ground-truth replaces generated actions with original rationales and answers when available, Open-source Only removes UltraInteract, and UltraInteract Only removes the general mixture. Result: the full recipe averages 53.6, versus 44.0 for Ground-truth, 37.0 for Open-source Only, and 47.7 for UltraInteract Only, absolute differences of 9.6, 16.6, and 5.9 points. Boundary: this supports the utility of generated actions and the complementarity of the mixed recipe in the reported 7B setting, but the removal variants change data volume, the ground-truth variant falls back to UltraInteract rationales when a source has none, and the experiment does not isolate preference trees, critiques, and code actions one at a time.

# 证据

主张：UltraInteract 生成并检查过的动作，比原始来源答案或单独的通用对齐混合数据提供更有效的推理监督。受控设置：表 5 在代码、数学、BBH 与 IFEval 的平均结果上评测 Eurus-7B-SFT；完整配方使用 UltraInteract 加通用 SFT 混合，标准答案组在可用时用原始推理和答案替换生成动作，仅开放数据组移除 UltraInteract，仅 UltraInteract 组移除通用混合。结果：完整配方平均为 53.6，标准答案组为 44.0，仅开放数据组为 37.0，仅 UltraInteract 组为 47.7，绝对差分别为 9.6、16.6 和 5.9 分。边界：结果支持生成动作在所报 7B 设置中的效用，也说明两类数据具有互补性；但删除组同时改变数据量，标准答案组在来源没有推理时仍使用 UltraInteract 推理，而且实验没有逐一隔离偏好树、批评和代码动作。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
# Novelty

CodeAct-style datasets already recorded model actions and environment feedback, but typically treated a completed trajectory as one demonstration rather than organizing alternative actions around every instruction and turn. UltraInteract changes the auditable object to a preference tree whose objectively correct nodes or correct-ending paths can be consumed as SFT targets and whose correct/incorrect branches can also support preference learning. This makes failed attempts, critiques, parent relations, and selection decisions available at the same construction boundary. Tool execution, CoT prompting, and preference optimization themselves are not new; the change is their tree-structured data contract and dual export.

# 新意

CodeAct 一类数据已经记录模型动作与环境反馈，但通常把完成后的轨迹视为一条示范，而不会围绕每条指令及每一轮组织替代动作。UltraInteract 把可审计对象改成偏好树：客观正确的节点或正确结束的路径可作为 SFT 目标，正确与错误分支还可用于偏好学习。这样，失败尝试、批评、父子关系和筛选决定便处在同一个构造边界内。工具执行、思维链提示和偏好优化本身并非新组件；真正变化的是树状数据契约及其双重导出方式。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
# Limitations

  • Correct answer is not a proof of a correct rationale. Most acceptance signals check the final answer, tests, or execution, so a trace with invalid intermediate claims can still survive; before reuse, sample each task family and audit step-level faithfulness rather than treating response as verified reasoning.
  • The central ablation does not equalize all data budgets. Removing UltraInteract or the general mixture changes both composition and row count, so the 53.6 versus 37.0 or 47.7 gaps cannot be attributed to one tree component; reproduce with fixed sample and token budgets before claiming a per-record advantage.
  • Release lineage needs reconciliation. The current SFT file has 288,579 rows versus 286,979 correct answers in Table 1, while the pair file has 219,522 rows versus 219,819 reported pairs, and aggregate MIT tags do not settle all upstream terms; pin revisions, explain count deltas, and audit each source license before redistribution.

# 局限

  • 答案正确不等于推理过程正确。 多数接受信号只检查最终答案、测试用例或执行结果，因此中间论证有误的轨迹仍可能保留；复用前应按任务类型抽样检查逐步忠实性，不能把 response 直接视为已验证推理。
  • 中心消融没有统一全部数据预算。 移除 UltraInteract 或通用混合数据会同时改变组成和记录数量，所以 53.6 与 37.0 或 47.7 的差距不能归因于单个树组件；声称单条记录更有效之前，应在固定样本数和 token 预算下复现。
  • 发布谱系仍需核对。 当前 SFT 文件有 288,579 条记录，而表 1 报告 286,979 个正确答案；当前偏好文件有 219,522 条记录，而论文报告 219,819 个偏好对，聚合数据的 MIT 标签也不能解决全部上游条款；再分发前应固定版本、解释数量差异并逐一审计来源许可。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
# Usefulness

Reasoning SFT builder: Start with checkable math, coding, or logic instructions and a capable actor, reuse the marked-action plus execution-feedback recipe, and export instruction/response records with parent lineage. The output is an SFT corpus whose success should be tested against a source-answer baseline at fixed token budget; do not reuse the acceptance rule when final answers cannot be checked reliably.

Data auditor: Load both official Parquet files, join id and parent_id, and inspect whether SFT responses correspond to correct branches while pair trajectories preserve the failed context that motivated correction. The output is a lineage and label-consistency report; success requires schema, count, duplicate, checker false-positive, and source-license results rather than only model scores.

Mixture designer: Combine UltraInteract demonstrations with a controlled general-instruction subset, train the same base model under full, source-answer, no-UltraInteract, and UltraInteract-only conditions, and report per-domain accuracy plus instruction-following regression. Use this only when compute permits matched training budgets and a frozen evaluation split; otherwise Table 5's composition and size effects remain confounded.

# 用途

推理 SFT 构建者：从可检查的数学、代码或逻辑指令和能力足够的生成模型出发，复用“带标记动作加执行反馈”的配方，并导出保留父子谱系的指令与回答记录。产物是 SFT 语料，成功标准是在固定 token 预算下优于源答案基线；若最终答案无法可靠检查，就不应沿用这套接受规则。

数据审计者：加载两个官方 Parquet 文件，用编号和父编号连接记录，检查 SFT 回答是否来自正确分支，以及偏好轨迹是否保留促成纠错的失败上下文。产物是谱系与标签一致性报告；成功检查必须覆盖字段、数量、重复、检查器假阳性和来源许可，而不能只看模型分数。

混合数据设计者：把 UltraInteract 示范与受控的通用指令子集结合，在同一基础模型上训练完整、源答案替换、不含 UltraInteract 和仅含 UltraInteract 四种设置，并报告各领域准确率与指令遵循退化。只有算力允许匹配训练预算且评测切分固定时才适合这样使用，否则表 5 的数据组成和规模影响仍互相混杂。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
# Reading notes

  • Positioning: general alignment data did not combine hard reasoning, tools, feedback, and objective correctness, so UltraInteract serializes those signals into one preference-tree corpus.
  • Method handle: challenge selection, 20-action retries, ground-truth-assisted fallback, failed-branch critique, and a five-turn cap determine which actions survive.
  • Data/artifact handle: the non-gated MIT releases currently expose 288,579 SFT rows and 219,522 pair rows in Parquet; an actual SFT row contains task, dataset, instruction, response, id, and parent_id.
  • Evidence anchor: Table 5's full Eurus-7B-SFT recipe averages 53.6 versus 44.0 with source ground truth, 37.0 without UltraInteract, and 47.7 with UltraInteract alone, but removal budgets are not matched.
  • Reuse decision: use the SFT release for checkable reasoning demonstrations after pinning revisions, reconciling source terms, explaining count deltas, and measuring step-level checker false positives.

# 阅读笔记

  • 一句话定位：通用对齐数据没有同时覆盖困难推理、工具、反馈和客观正确性，UltraInteract 因此把这些信号序列化为一套偏好树语料。
  • 方法抓手：困难题筛选、每轮 20 个动作、标准答案辅助回退、失败分支批评和五轮上限，共同决定哪些动作能够保留。
  • 数据与产物抓手：无需审批的 MIT 发布目前提供 288,579 条 SFT 记录和 219,522 条 Parquet 偏好记录；实际读取的 SFT 记录含任务、源数据集、指令、回答、编号和父编号。
  • 证据锚点：表 5 中完整的 Eurus-7B-SFT 配方平均为 53.6，源标准答案为 44.0，不含 UltraInteract 为 37.0，仅 UltraInteract 为 47.7，但删除组的训练预算并未匹配。
  • 复用决定：适合构造可检查的推理示范；使用前必须固定发布版本、核对来源条款、解释数量差异，并测量逐步检查的假阳性。

value.html: 85,918 instructions selected from twelve math, coding, and logic datasets, emphasizing problems that GPT-3.5-Turbo fails and datasets with ground-truth solutions.

The SFT release stores task, source dataset, instruction, step-by-step response, id, and parent_id; the companion preference release stores the interaction trajectory plus chosen and rejected actions.

GPT-3.5-Turbo is the default actor; a pool of open actors supplies diverse incorrect actions, stronger actors up to GPT-4 Turbo are used when correct actions are hard to obtain, and GPT-4 writes critiques with ground-truth references.

items: instruction and step-marked text or code response
environment observation and critique in multi-turn trajectories
chosen and rejected actions in the companion pair release

value.html: Python execution for tool-using math and coding, Wikipedia search for selected logic tasks, and textual critique conditioned on interaction history and ground truth.

Dataset ground-truth answers or test cases and Python execution provide objective correctness; GPT-4 Turbo judges Magicoder-Evol-Instruct records, which are excluded from preference pairs because that judgment is less rigorous.
A correct action closes its branch; an incorrect action may be expanded with observation and critique, with each preference tree capped at five turns.
Mistral-7B for Eurus-7B-SFT and CodeLLaMA-70B for Eurus-70B-SFT.
GPT-3.5-Turbo is the default actor, GPT-4 supplies critiques, and stronger actors up to GPT-4 Turbo support difficult correct-action sampling.

The actor decomposes a problem, samples a CoT or modular-programming plan, and writes marked text or executable-code actions; incorrect branches receive environment and critique feedback before another turn.

Sample 20 actions per attempt, retry up to three rounds with progressively stronger actors, then expose ground-truth rationales or answers for remaining hard problems; expand incorrect branches for at most five turns.

Retain objectively correct actions for SFT, pair correct and syntax-valid incorrect actions for preference learning, exclude Magicoder from pairs, and remove benchmark instructions with exact or 8-gram overlap.
Up to three 20-action sampling rounds before ground-truth-assisted elicitation; preference trees stop after at most five turns.
Eurus SFT runs one epoch at learning rate 2e-5 with cosine decay and 0.1 warmup; the 7B mixture adds 32K UltraChat, 30K ShareGPT, and 50K OpenOrca examples.
UltraInteract draws from GSM8K, MATH, MathQA, NumGLUE, TabMWP, CodeContest, TACO, WikiTableQuestions, Magicoder-Evol-Instruct, ReClor, HotpotQA, and StrategyQA.
The official Hugging Face SFT release exposes one train split with 288,579 Parquet rows; the pair release exposes one train split with 219,522 rows.
LeetCode uses exact-substring matching; other same-task test sets use 8-gram exact matching, and overlapping instructions are removed.

items: Final-answer or execution correctness does not prove that every intermediate rationale step is valid.
GPT-4 Turbo rather than an objective checker judges Magicoder-Evol-Instruct actions, so those records are unsuitable for the paper's preference-pair contract.
The released SFT row count, 288,579, is 1,600 above the paper's 286,979 correct-answer count, and the release does not document that delta.
MIT metadata on the aggregate release does not replace a component-by-component license and provenance audit of the twelve source datasets.

value.html: Both official Hugging Face releases are tagged MIT; component prompts, answers, and environments inherit source-specific terms that require separate review.

Public reasoning instructions are challenge-filtered, expanded into preference trees by actor models, checked against ground truth or execution, and exported as correct SFT actions plus a companion chosen/rejected trajectory corpus.
